ApplyArchiveRule.description_en: Archives findings that match the specified archive rule
ApplyArchiveRule.description_zh: 将符合归档规则的 Finding 结果执行归档操作

CreateAnalyzer.description_en: Creates an Analyzer to perform over-privilege or external access analysis on an account or resource directory
CreateAnalyzer.description_zh: 创建一个新的Analyzer对账号或资源目录进行过度授权或外部访问分析

CreateArchiveRule.description_en: Creates an archive rule for an analyzer to automatically archive findings that meet the specified conditions
CreateArchiveRule.description_zh: 为分析器创建一个新的归档规则，以便自动归档符合条件的Findings

DeleteAnalyzer.description_en: Deletes an Analyzer with the specified name

DeleteArchiveRule.description_en: Deletes an archive rule under a specified Analyzer
DeleteArchiveRule.description_zh: 用于删除指定Analyzer下的归档规则

GenerateFindingRecommendation.description_en: Generates governance recommendations based on the specified analyzer and finding
GenerateFindingRecommendation.description_zh: 根据指定的Analyzer和Finding生成治理建议

GetAnalyzedResource.description_en: Queries the analysis details of a specified resource in the Analyzer
GetAnalyzedResource.description_zh: 查询指定资源在Analyzer中的分析详情

GetAnalyzer.description_en: Queries the details of an analyzer with a specified name
GetAnalyzer.description_zh: 查询指定名称的Analyzer详细信息

GetArchiveRule.description_en: Queries the details of an archive rule under a specified analyzer
GetArchiveRule.description_zh: 查询指定分析器下的归档规则详情

GetFinding.description_en: Queries the details of a specified finding

GetFindingRecommendation.description_en: Queries the governance recommendations generated for a specified finding
GetFindingRecommendation.description_zh: 查询为指定Finding生成的治理建议方案

GetFindingsStatistics.description_en: Retrieves the findings statistics information for a specified analyzer
GetFindingsStatistics.description_zh: 获取指定Analyzer的分析结果统计信息

ListAnalyzers.description_en: Lists all analyzers and supports filtering results by specified conditions
ListAnalyzers.description_zh: 列出所有Analyzer列表，支持通过筛选条件过滤结果

ListArchiveRules.description_en: Queries all archive rules under a specified analyzer
ListArchiveRules.description_zh: 查询指定分析器下的所有归档规则

ListFindings.description_en: Lists all findings under a specified analyzer. You can filter results by specifying filter conditions
ListFindings.description_zh: 列出指定 Analyzer 下的所有 Finding，支持通过筛选条件过滤结果

StartResourceScan.description_en: Initiates an analysis scan for a specified resource
StartResourceScan.description_zh: 对指定资源主动发起一次分析扫描

UpdateFindings.description_en: Modifies the status of one or more specified findings. Findings with a status of Resolved cannot be modified
UpdateFindings.description_zh: 修改指定一个或多个 Finding 的状态，无法修改状态为已解决的 Finding

ValidatePolicy.description_en: Validates an access policy and returns a list of analysis results
ValidatePolicy.description_zh: 请求验证策略并返回分析结果列表
